text: We have duplicate activities after the Northwind backfill. Could we drop rows when another activity has the same timestamp?
Maybe as a quick cleanup, but I don't want that as the import rule yet.
Timestamp alone is unsafe. A call system can emit two legitimate events in the same second.
Agreed. The vendor payload has event_id. Tenant plus source event ID should be stable across a repeated backfill.
Decision: reject timestamp dedupe. Use (tenant_id, source_event_id), document it in ADR-014, and cover same-timestamp distinct events.
That also gives support a clean explanation for why we need the vendor event ID.
Reminder: engineering demo begins in 10 minutes.
